tool.name: impg refine
tool.description: tighten a locus to maximize spanning sample support
tool.command: @SETUP_ALIGNMENTS@ impg refine @ALIGNMENT_ARGS@ #if str($query_region.mode) == "single" -r '$query_region.target_range' #else -b '$query_region.target_bed' #end if @CMD_MERGE_DISTANCE@ --span-bp $refine_opts.span_bp --max-extension $refine_opts.max_extension --extension-step $refine_opts.extension_step #if str($refine_opts.pansn_mode) != "none" --pansn-mode $refine_opts.pansn_mode #end if #if $refine_opts.blacklist_bed --blacklist-bed '$refine_opts.blacklist_bed' #end if #if $support_output --support-output '$support_out' #end if @CMD_TRANSITIVE@ @CMD_INDEX_OPTS@ #if str($coords.original_sequence_coordinates) == "true" --original-sequence-coordinates #end if @THREADS@ > '$output'

param.name: support_output
param.label: Emit spanning-entity support file
param.help: Write a BED file listing the entities (sequences, samples, or haplotypes) that span the refined region.

param.label: Span bp
param.help: Minimum number of bases that supporting samples must span at each region boundary.

param.label: Max extension
param.help: Maximum per-side extension explored when maximizing boundary support. Values <= 1 are fractions of the locus length; values > 1 are absolute bp.

validator.message: A number (e.g. 0.5 for a fraction, or 50000 for absolute bp)

param.label: PanSN aggregation mode
param.help: How to count support: by sequence (default), by PanSN sample, or by haplotype.

param.name: blacklist_bed
param.label: Blacklist BED
param.help: Ranges to blacklist when counting maximum possible entities.

tool.help:
**impg refine** — tighten a locus to maximize spanning support
Explores asymmetric left/right expansions around each range and picks the smallest window that keeps the most sequences, samples, or haplotypes fully spanning it. Useful for anchoring loci outside structural variants so downstream tools receive comparable, well-supported regions.
-----
**Input**
- One or more PAF files (optionally bgzipped). - A **target range** or a **BED file** of regions. - **Merge distance** (required).
**Output**
- A tabular report (`#chrom`, `start`, `end`, `name`, `original.support`, `new.support`, `left.extension.bp`, `right.extension.bp`). - Optionally a **spanning-entity support** BED file.
**Key options**
- **Span bp**: minimum bases a supporting entity must span at each boundary (default 1000). - **Max extension**: per-side search budget, as a fraction of the locus (≤1) or absolute bp (>1). Default 0.5. - **PanSN mode**: count support by `sample` or `haplotype` instead of by sequence.
